description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta defends his decision to settle an antitrust lawsuit with Paramount that was delaying the company's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. description:
In his UN General Assembly address, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Iran will never bend to US President Donald Trump and asserted Iranians have been “the victims of terrorism.” A US delegate in the room walked out.

Pezeshkian started his speech to the assembly by highlighting the deadly US strike on an Iranian elementary school at the outset of the war, saying Iranians have “been the victims of terrorism.” He stressed that Iran is seeking nuclear technology “for progress, not to threaten societies with weapons,” adding that his country wishes “to cooperate and collaborate for security.” The Iranian leader also called on other countries to collaborate in order to pursue “true peace and stability” in the face of what he described as “bullying.”

description:
With President Donald Trump at record unpopularity, Republicans are facing an even bleaker midterm political landscape than they did eight years ago, a new CNN poll conducted by SSRS finds. 

Nationally, voters say they prefer Democratic candidates over Republicans by an eight-point margin – slightly more modest than their 12-point advantage in CNN’s September polling ahead of the 2018 midterms in Trump’s first presidency. 

CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten and CNN political director David Chalian pore through the new numbers, plus reaction from CNN's Jake Tapper and Audie Cornish's CNN This Morning "group chat."

2:55 Voter perception of Trump's handling of gas prices

description:
The Justice Department said late Tuesday that CNN, MS NOW and Politico can be shut out from areas of the White House at the president’s will. The lawyers argue that the outlets’ coverage of the Iran war and of President Donald Trump’s ballroom construction could amount to a national security risk that justifies the ban.

The filings came on the eve of an emergency hearing before federal judge Timothy Kelly in Washington, DC. CNN, MS NOW and Politico are asking for the court to immediately restore their access to the White House.

author: CNN
description:
Utah GOP Senator John Curtis is demanding the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate reports that a Russian oligarch helped fund Donald Trump Jr.’s wedding celebration. In a formal letter, the Utah Republican called for a dual review of both the Trump and Biden family business dealings to help restore public trust.

The move has triggered a major Republican rift, with key Judiciary Committee members Thom Tillis of North Carolina and John Cornyn of Texas backing the probe. Tillis publicly criticized the president's son for "colossally bad judgment," while Cornyn agreed that a formal investigation is entirely appropriate as the party faces looming midterm elections.
